notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-1.99.5.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - Tu dong thiet ke khu WC nha xuong theo so nguoi va so khu WC tung tang (gan khu chuc nang -> WC, hoac nhap tay), xem truoc mat bang, chon 2 diem tren Revit (bam goc theo truc) roi dung that thanh Model Group. - Bo cuc tu chon dien tich nho nhat: lung tua lung / noi tiep / xoay khoi 90 do; buong xi giu module (kho nhan phan du), WC nu dang cot; tieu nam: thang, chu L hoac chu U, tu chon gon nhat; tu loi vao khong nhin thang toi tieu; thong thuy truoc tieu 1200 (2 nguoi tranh nhau).
